units.source_text: 船上有我的朋友——两位女学生和我快到八岁的弟弟。

en.t: On the boat were my friends: two schoolgirls and my younger brother, who was almost eight years old.
The helmsman was a high school student.

units.source_text: 连三明治、白兰瓜和冰激凌都装上船了。

en.t: Even sandwiches, melons, and ice cream had been loaded onto the boat.

units.source_text: 他们打算一早扬帆，向前方距海岸有二里地的避暑地驶去。

en.t: They planned to set sail early in the morning and head for a summer resort about two ri off the coast ahead.
